goal: Exercise the Pass Orchestrator end-to-end with three small, harmless, documentation-only sub-passes that add and cross-link contributor-facing docs, without touching any application code.
global_constraints: Only add or edit Markdown files under docs/ and the repository root README.md.
Never touch the main branch; all work happens on pass_branch only.
Never commit unrelated or accidental files (build output, .vs/, bin/, obj/).

sub_passes.title: Add CONTRIBUTING.md
sub_passes.objective: Create a top-level CONTRIBUTING.md describing how to propose changes to this repository.
acceptance_criteria: CONTRIBUTING.md exists at the repository root.
It explains how to open issues/PRs and references that the project uses the @claude GitHub Action for assisted changes.

sub_passes.title: Cross-link docs from README
sub_passes.objective: Add a short 'Documentation' section to README.md linking to docs/claude-connectivity-test.md and the new CONTRIBUTING.md.
acceptance_criteria: The section links to CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/claude-connectivity-test.md.
All pre-existing README content is preserved unchanged (append-only diff).

sub_passes.title: Summarize the example pass in docs/
sub_passes.objective: Add docs/pass-orchestrator-example-notes.md summarizing what sub-passes .1 and .2 did, as a worked example of orchestrator output.
acceptance_criteria: It briefly describes sub-passes docs-example.1 and docs-example.2 and links back to the pass plan file pass-plans/example-docs-pass.json.

requirements: Exactly three checkpoint commits exist on pass_branch beyond base_branch, one per sub-pass, in order.
The cumulative diff from base_branch to HEAD touches only: CONTRIBUTING.md, README.md, docs/pass-orchestrator-example-notes.md.
StudentPlannerApp/**, StudentPlannerApp.sln, and .github/workflows/** are byte-for-byte unchanged versus base_branch.
main was never checked out for writes and was never pushed to.
No force-push occurred at any point.
